lines.1: The afternoon period was PE. Baseball.
lines.2: It was already late May, but the temperature was pleasant today.
lines.4: 「Tch. You snagged the sweet job of umpire. Must be nice taking it easy. Man, this is such a pain.」
lines.6: 「Is Fukahire up next? All right, knock it all the way to Matsukasa Park!」
lines.7: 「...With the Princess's encouragement powering me up, I'm stronger than the Eagulls with Iwaguma on the mound.」
lines.8: 「Strike! And that's three swings, you're out!」
lines.10: 「And after I went to the trouble of cheering for you. Well, I suppose that's all you had.」
lines.12: 「Hah! If we baseball-club guys don't show off now, when will we? Don't underestimate the bite on my forkball!」
lines.13: 「Hey, other team! What's wrong with you?! Not one ball's made it out to center!」
lines.14: 「Would you look at that? Everyone starts showing off the second girls are watching.」
